reviews.text: Niiki is a 5-year-old female dog who brings joy to Emma and her grandparents. Five years ago, Cláudia, Emma's mother and our daughter, discovered her online and, in the midst of the Covid pandemic, bought her in Segovia. Then, a Spanish van crossed the border bringing us a ball of wool that charmed everyone. But a year after her arrival, nature made a mistake and surprisingly brought a fatal illness to Cláudia, forcing us to find a new home for Niiki – Emma's grandparents' house, our house. Because of all this, she is a very special dog in this family, and every illness or discomfort she suffers leaves us on high alert. That's how, a week ago, a serious uterine infection required emergency surgery at the Campo Alegre Veterinary Clinic where Niiki is regularly treated. From diagnosis to surgery, it was a quick process, under the care of Dr. Miguel, the veterinarian who attended to us. Seven days later, Nikki is as if nothing had happened (removal of her uterus and ovaries), thanks to the accurate diagnosis and laparoscopic surgery performed by Dr. Miguel's team. In addition, we must also highlight the punctuality of the scheduled appointments and the friendliness and competence of all the clinic staff. Hooray!

The Campo Alegre team is phenomenal! From the initial welcome to the final process my Lazy was involved in! Dr. Renata Freitas was exemplary throughout the entire process, and unfortunately, because there was no solution to the problem, Lazy fell asleep! Thank you for everything you did for Lazy!
Thank you so much for your feedback, Margarida! We hope to welcome you back again soon.

This is the veterinary clinic for my furry friends. That says it all.
Thank you to the team for their kindness and professionalism, and my heartfelt thanks to Dr. Miguel. Our vet of choice.
Thank you very much, Miguel, for trusting our team at the Campo Alegre Veterinary Clinic. We will be available whenever you need us.

Excellent service at all levels. Highly qualified and knowledgeable professionals. Dr. Filipe Urbano is incredibly trustworthy!!!

Congratulations!
Thank you, Dmitrii, for your trust in our team and for such a positive assessment of our work. Your satisfaction is our greatest reward.
It does not matter which veterinary you get, it is sure that your pet will have the best care possible.

Do not take your pet to this veterinarian. I was a client for a long time, and I have to tell you that I've seen absurd things there, like insects and fleas climbing the walls of the consulting room, the doctor dropping my dog ​​off the table, my dog ​​having diarrhea on the floor and the doctor refusing to clean it up and letting my dog ​​walk in the feces, and I had to ask her to clean it up, and she used a dry paper towel that left traces on the floor anyway. The receptionists tried to charge more, they took my dog ​​to another room and he started screaming. My dog ​​is a sweetheart and is terrified of this veterinarian. They also don't have enough equipment to be considered a veterinarian; they literally only know how to do blood tests (but I've had more than one done and the results were exactly the same in all of them, I suspect they falsify documents). If your pet has a problem, you'll leave there with a dog with the same problem, traumatized and with fleas. THIS PLACE IS A SCAM, BEWARE!

Horrible! I'm only giving it one star because otherwise they might delete it. I went to this vet for two years and I have to tell you that besides mistreating the animals (that's why they never let you see them doing anything, even something as simple as a vaccination takes the dog to another place despite the vet being tiny) they do FAKE tests!!!!! My dog ​​had a problem, we did several tests, several times, and they always said the dog was fine. They avoided sending the results; we always had to constantly ask because they send fake documents. They don't actually do the tests on the dog, you don't witness anything, and they only call to say the results were x, and there's NO proof of ANYTHING, and when they do send them, they're fake documents. This place should be investigated by the police.

My kitten was seen by Maria Inês. She is an up-to-date professional and knows how to communicate with pet owners even during difficult times. I recommend the clinic; all the professionals I've had contact with have been excellent.
Suggestion for improvement: a dedicated waiting area for kittens.
Spectacular service!
Thank you very much, Dulcineia, for trusting Clínica Veterinária do Campo Alegre.
I really like the clinic! They are always very professional and prioritize friendliness ☺️
Thank you very much, Filomena, for taking the time to write your review. We are happy to know that you are satisfied with our service. We will continue to be available whenever you need us.
Thank you for the feedback, António, come back whenever you need to!
Very efficient with excellent service and a quick and efficient response in emergencies.
Thank you for the feedback, come back anytime!

I am making this criticism solely due to the habitual and excessive waiting time for service. Despite it being a medical clinic, susceptible to unforeseen events, it is easy to see the serious disorganization (combined with ill will disguised as pseudo-sympathy) on the part of the reception staff. The disrespect ranges from a delay of almost half an hour for a simple registration, to personal phone calls to the detriment of the waiting client. Complaints are made and the problem persists. There is a need for significant improvement in respecting patients and their guardians. Were it not for my personal trust in the medical-professional relationship, I would never return to the clinic.
Baking

I had a terrible experience at this clinic! My 5-month-old puppy suddenly lost her appetite and became very tired. I took her to this clinic for them to examine her and perform the necessary tests. I was told that they would contact me during the afternoon to keep me updated on the situation, however, no one called. When I arrived at the end of the day, they had done blood tests and an ultrasound, and the results left no doubt: it was a chronic degenerative kidney disease. The only thing to do was give her IV fluids… The next day she went back and was put on IV fluids again. At the end of the day, I picked up the puppy, and the situation was chaotic. The puppy had spent the day in a cage on IV fluids, and when they handed her back to me, she immediately urinated an unacceptable amount because she had spent the day receiving IV fluids without being made to urinate…
The clinical scenario remained the same, and they suggested taking her home overnight or taking her to a veterinary hospital! It was our luck that all the most likely scenarios weren't ruled out at the clinic, and those were the ones that were evaluated at the hospital, ultimately saving the dog!
I fear that if we hadn't changed hospitals, my dog ​​would have died. A huge lack of competence! Don't leave your animals at this clinic!

The best!

I went to the clinic on a recommendation. My kitten had a problem with her ears. At the clinic I went to before, they wanted to do a biopsy on one of her ears. Dr. Joana decided to administer medication for the fungus and avoid the biopsy. I am grateful for the diagnosis. My kitten suffered for months without a precise diagnosis. When she finally started to get better, it was a relief. My Lua also thanks you! 😃 Although it was a few months ago, it's never too late to give thanks.

Woof woof!

I'm Minnie Mel and I love my veterinary clinic! Every time I go there, I'm greeted with so much affection by everyone. A special mention to Dr. Miguel, who takes care of me with such attention, and to the incredible nurses Maria João and Daniela, who always shower me with love and cuddles. Thank you for taking such good care of me! I recommend it to all my furry friends!

We love our vet. You can tell they care about the animals and take very good care of them!  We have always received great service from ALL of the staff. Our cat has gotten his updated shots as well as a tooth removed.  This vet can do it all! They even got his EU passport!  Pricing isn't bad either! Highly recommend!
I've been a customer for many years and with many animals behind me! A loving attitude towards animals is the first sign of success.

From the moment I entered the clinic, I was greeted by an attentive and helpful team. The environment was clean and well-organized, and I was immediately impressed with the type of treatment we received. There was always immense care and attention given to my dog.

Dr. Beatriz Santos demonstrated a deep veterinary knowledge, and during the consultation, she quickly arrived at a correct diagnosis. She explained the cause and answered all my questions clearly. I really liked how she approached my dog ​​(who was scared) and how much she cared about his well-being.

After the consultation, I received clear instructions on the necessary care and treatment to be followed.

I became a client!

Dedicated, efficient, and professional team.
Thank you ;)

I am grateful to the entire team at the Campo Alegre Veterinary Clinic who tirelessly cared for my cat Métis at the end of her life, especially Dr. Miguel Soares. He was very humane and understanding towards me.

Now I am embarking on a new journey with two baby kittens, Eros and Psiquê. Dr. Beatriz Santos has been very attentive, patient, available, and always welcomes us with a smile! Thank you so much.

Certainly, if Métis, Eros, and Psiquê could write, they would share the same gratitude. God bless you!

I am very satisfied with the level of services in this clinic. The doctors and nurses treat the animal with a huge respect and kindness.I can’t imagine treating my animal in any other place. My highest recommendations!
A clinic where Dr. Beatriz Santos is an excellent doctor and takes care of the animals like you don't see anywhere else. Always concerned and super attentive. Fantastic.
Fantastic team, always attentive and careful with my German Shepherd. They resolved my pet's health problem very quickly. I highly recommend the Campo Alegre veterinary clinic!

Competent, attentive, and dedicated professionals. A small clinic, but perfectly equipped and prepared for any eventuality. Having already used the services of several veterinary hospitals in Porto, the Campo Alegre Veterinary Clinic is currently my first choice.
